name.text: Bright Horizons Columbus Courtyard Day Nursery and Preschool

description.text:
Part of Bright Horizons Family, Columbus Courtyard Day Nursery and Preschool (formerly Little Unicorns) had a major refurbishment in July 2016.

With floor to ceiling windows in every room, this nursery has an abundance of natural light and lovely large rooms to accommodate big adventures. There is a large play room which has a big bulldozer, playhouse, mural wall with outdoor scenes and a track for lots of adventures.

The nursery offers a wide variety of engaging activities, which encourage children to learn and explore in a home from home environment. Children are well-prepared for the transition to school with the unique Bright Horizons Ready for School Programmes, including Growing Readers, Writers and Mathematicians.

Part of Bright Horizons Family, which received the Royal Society for the Prevention of Accidents (ROSPA) award in April 2016.
